Title: Azure Cosmos DB—Save up to 33 percent on multi-master accounts

Body.Content: Customers creating new Azure Cosmos DB accounts can now get discounted pricing up to 33 percent off for accounts enabling multi-region writes (multi-master). To take advantage of this pricing, visit the Azure portal and create a new account with multi-region writes enabled.
